rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP-Apifox is a server implementation that provides AI assistants with access to Apifox API documentation through the Model Context Protocol. It offers tools to extract project and API IDs from Apifox URLs and fetch detailed API information using authentication tokens. The server runs on stdio transport, making it compatible with Claude Desktop integration, and requires an Apifox access token provided either through environment variables or command-line arguments. This implementation is particularly valuable for developers who need to reference or analyze API documentation within their AI assistant conversations without switching contexts.
